source_title: All 3D Printer Recipes & Ingredients in MW4 DMZ - GameRant
source_excerpt:
Once you reach DMZ Level 2 , you will have access to the 3D Printer. This is the most important FOB Station you have, as it's how you can upgrade other FOB Stations and spend Printer Ingredients and DMZ Cash to unlock vital equipment, from infinite Parachutes, 3-Plate Armor Vests, Backpacks, and more. If you're looking for every recipe and the ingredients you need, then consult the full table below that covers all 107+ recipes for MW4 DMZ .
